d5b48b13-5ec2-4c1b-ae59-1056f621cf7d.name: Path to CTO
d5b48b13-5ec2-4c1b-ae59-1056f621cf7d.job_description: Looking for a PM with SQL and Product Sense.

conflicts.description: The target role is for a Product Manager, but the user profile is for a Backend Developer. There is a significant mismatch in the core responsibilities and required skill sets.

suggested_patch.title: Transition to Product Management
action_items: Understand the core principles of Product Management.
Learn about product lifecycle, market research, user story creation, and roadmap planning.
Gain experience in user research and customer feedback analysis.
Develop skills in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
Seek opportunities to contribute to product-related discussions and initiatives within the current role or through side projects.
resources: Coursera: Product Management Specialization
Udemy: The Complete Product Management Course
Product School: Certified Product Manager (CPM) Program
Books: 'Inspired: How to Create Tech Products Customers Love' by Marty Cagan, 'The Lean Startup' by Eric Ries

conflicts.description: The job description explicitly mentions 'Product Sense' as a required skill, which is not directly listed in the user's current skills.

suggested_patch.title: Develop Product Sense
action_items: Analyze successful and unsuccessful products to understand the factors contributing to their success or failure.
Practice identifying user needs and pain points.
Develop the ability to translate business goals into product features.
Engage in case studies and problem-solving exercises related to product strategy.
Seek mentorship from experienced product managers.
resources: Articles and blogs on product strategy and user empathy (e.g., Reforge, Mind the Product)
Product case study websites
Online courses focusing on user experience and product strategy

conflicts.description: The user profile lists 'Python, Django, REST APIs, SQL, Git, Communication' as skills. While SQL is mentioned in the job description, the core focus of the target role is Product Management, not Backend Development.

suggested_patch.title: Acquire Product Management Core Skills
action_items: Complete a comprehensive Product Management certification or course.
Actively participate in product strategy discussions and contribute ideas.
Seek opportunities to shadow or work with Product Managers.
Build a portfolio of product-related projects or analyses.
resources: Product School: Certified Product Manager (CPM)
General Assembly: Product Management Course
Books: 'Cracking the PM Interview' by Gayle Laakmann McDowell and Jackie Bavaro
